verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for an AI app-building tool, but the evidence pack shows no documented way to define rules that fire actions automatically on events. The closest items are adjacent features: reusable instruction sets for frequent workflows, MCP connections for external context, and parallel chats. All of these are user-initiated, not event-driven.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
